mapper.select: SELECT B.ID AS BOARD_ID, B.TITLE, B.CONTENT, B.VIEW_COUNT, B.LIKE_COUNT, B.COMMENT_COUNT, B.CREATED_AT, B.UPDATED_AT, B.DELETED_AT, M.ID AS WRITER_ID, M.NAME AS WRITER_NAME, M.PASSWORD AS WRITER_PASSWORD FROM BOARDS B, MEMBERS M WHERE B.WRITER_ID = M.ID AND DELETED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY B.ID DESC

SELECT B.ID AS BOARD_ID, B.TITLE, B.CONTENT, B.VIEW_COUNT, B.LIKE_COUNT, B.COMMENT_COUNT, B.CREATED_AT, B.UPDATED_AT, B.DELETED_AT, M.ID AS WRITER_ID, M.NAME AS WRITER_NAME, M.PASSWORD AS WRITER_PASSWORD FROM BOARDS B, MEMBERS M WHERE B.WRITER_ID = M.ID AND DELETED_AT IS NULL AND (B.TITLE LIKE #{keyword} OR B.CONTENT LIKE #{keyword}) ORDER BY B.ID DESC

SELECT B.ID AS BOARD_ID, B.TITLE, B.CONTENT, B.VIEW_COUNT, B.LIKE_COUNT, B.COMMENT_COUNT, B.CREATED_AT, B.UPDATED_AT, B.DELETED_AT, M.ID AS WRITER_ID, M.NAME AS WRITER_NAME, M.PASSWORD AS WRITER_PASSWORD FROM BOARDS B, MEMBERS M WHERE B.WRITER_ID = M.ID AND DELETED_AT IS NULL AND B.TITLE LIKE #{keyword} ORDER BY B.ID DESC

SELECT B.ID AS BOARD_ID, B.TITLE, B.CONTENT, B.VIEW_COUNT, B.LIKE_COUNT, B.COMMENT_COUNT, B.CREATED_AT, B.UPDATED_AT, B.DELETED_AT, M.ID AS WRITER_ID, M.NAME AS WRITER_NAME, M.PASSWORD AS WRITER_PASSWORD FROM BOARDS B, MEMBERS M WHERE B.WRITER_ID = M.ID AND DELETED_AT IS NULL AND B.CONTENT LIKE #{keyword} ORDER BY B.ID DESC

SELECT B.ID AS BOARD_ID, B.TITLE, B.CONTENT, B.VIEW_COUNT, B.LIKE_COUNT, B.COMMENT_COUNT, B.CREATED_AT, B.UPDATED_AT, B.DELETED_AT, M.ID AS WRITER_ID, M.NAME AS WRITER_NAME, M.PASSWORD AS WRITER_PASSWORD FROM BOARDS B, MEMBERS M WHERE B.WRITER_ID = M.ID AND DELETED_AT IS NULL AND B.ID = #{boardId}
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARDS SET DELETED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{boardId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARDS (TITLE, CONTENT, WRITER_ID) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{writerId})
